reviews.text: Such a wonderful experience, thank you Erika. We brought life back to my hair when she created a more lived in color. I've also been able to grow my hair out longer and healthier than ever. I walked away feeling beautiful and loving it. Beautiful Salon, great staff.

Ann did my haircut, highlights, and styling. I loved her professionalism and attention to detail. The salon ambience was also10/10 and I can’t wait to go back! I recommend Salon Renaissance to everyone!
I’ve been seeing Jenna for almost 10 years. She is magical and the ladies at this salon are all fantastic! 10/10!
